business_problem: Shopee needed specialized multilingual AI for ecommerce because general-purpose LLMs performed poorly on Southeast Asian shopping, fraud, and support tasks, limiting the platform's ability to scale search, recommendations, and customer interactions across languages and markets.
solution_summary: Shopee trained its Compass family of ecommerce models on NVIDIA GPU infrastructure so search, recommendations, fraud detection, and customer service could share a domain-specific multilingual foundation. The team used NVIDIA Megatron-Core and NVIDIA NeMo Framework to pretrain and align large mixture-of-experts models on proprietary product titles, reviews, ratings, and synthetic ecommerce instructions spanning major Southeast Asian languages. In production, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM accelerates model serving for high-volume commerce use cases, while the resulting models power search relevance, ad revenue, anti-fraud detection, logistics recovery, and context-aware support chat. Shopee also created its own EcomEval benchmark to measure these workloads directly rather than relying on English-centric general benchmarks. This architecture lets Shopee keep AI close to the realities of regional commerce and scale proprietary models into a platform-wide operational asset.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA Megatron-Core
solution_components.role: Supports large-scale pretraining of Shopee's multilingual ecommerce models.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA NeMo Framework
solution_components.role: Handles model customization and alignment for regional ecommerce tasks.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM
solution_components.role: Optimizes production serving for fraud, search, recommendation, and service workloads.

data_flow: Product content, ratings, reviews, and multilingual query signals are used to train Compass models, which are then served through TensorRT-LLM to support search, recommendations, fraud scoring, logistics analysis, and customer-service responses across Shopee's markets.
business_outcome: Shopee grew monthly API token volume from 3 billion to 340 billion in eight months, achieved 50x faster fraud detection at 90% lower cost, and scaled multilingual ecommerce AI into a shared platform for search, ad revenue, logistics, and customer support across hundreds of millions of users.
metrics: $136 billion in annual gross merchandise value

The same model family powers both user-facing and operational ecommerce workflows.
